description: This file contains functions for parsing /proc/[pid]/stat to extract process information, including process name and parent process ID, and collecting process ancestry data for tracing purposes.

methods.name: parse_proc_stat
methods.description: Parses the contents of /proc/[pid]/stat to extract the process name and parent process ID.

methods.name: stat_parent_pid
methods.description: Reads /proc/[pid]/stat and uses parse_proc_stat to get process info.

methods.name: push_ancestry_name
methods.description: Recursively collects the process ancestry names based on parent process IDs.

methods.name: trace2_collect_process_info
methods.description: Main function to collect and trace process ancestry information based on the reason provided.
